title: Woodknock Skank
description: A plucked woody dub skank bass: a short triangle pluck in the low/mid register, knocked at the attack by a pitch envelope and wobbled by a slow seasick vibrato so the pitch never quite settles. The motion is driven entirely by euclidean and ply rhythmic figures that re-group the off-beat skank over the loop (a swinging (3,8)/(5,8) pull plus every-4 ply doublings), while a ladder lowpass envelope shapes each pluck and a spring-style room plus a dub delay throw ring the notes out into liquid echoes. Across 16 cycles the rhythm regroups, the filter env breathes and the delay throws drift out of phase.
